Community & State
Initiatives

Creating equitable access to STEM learning across Kerala.

LEnSE follows an inclusive, socially responsible model. Programme fees collected from training activities are channeled to support disadvantaged students in rural schools across Kerala.

STATE & NATIONAL IMPACT

Key Outreach Initiatives

STATE-WIDE FLAGSHIP
Partner: Indian Council for Social Science Research (ICSSR), New Delhi

State-wide 'STEM 4 Girls' Camp Series

Supported by funding from ICSSR, this state-wide initiative empowers young women from economically and socially disadvantaged families across Kerala by delivering hands-on robotics, microcontroller coding, and scientific problem-solving camps.

Inaugurated by Finance Minister Sri. K. N. Balagopal; over 500+ girls empowered.
3 SelectedDistricts Covered
500+ GirlsParticipants
100% Free / FundedSupport Model
Puthoor (Kollam), Paruthippally (Thiruvananthapuram), Nedumkandam (Idukki)Request Camp at Your School
GOVERNMENT OF KERALA COLLABORATION
Partner: State Institute of Educational Technology (SIET), Govt. of Kerala

STEM Training for Gifted Students Across 41 Educational Districts

A comprehensive state-level program identifying and nurturing gifted school students. Features 3-day residential STEM bootcamps, hands-on science kits, and mentorship from leading educators.

Inaugurated by Hon’ble Education Minister Sri. V. Sivankutty at ASTI Manvila.
41 DistrictsEducational Districts
44 SchoolsSchools Engaged
State-wide SelectionGifted Cohort
All 41 Educational Districts across KeralaRequest Camp at Your School
GLOBAL ACADEMIC ENGAGEMENT
Partner: STEM Centre, Clarkson University, USA

LEnSE – Clarkson University International STEM Partnership

Brings international expertise, clean technology benchmarks, and advanced learning engineering to Kerala educators. Facilitates joint faculty exchange and sustainable curriculum frameworks.

Keynote addresses at the 4th SIET International Conference on Educational Technology.
InternationalScope
Clean Tech & PedagogyFocus Area
Faculty & ScholarsExchange

HANDS-ON INFRASTRUCTURE
Partner: LEnSE Innovation Facility

Dedicated STEM Learning Lab at Kazhakkoottam

A physical innovation hub equipped with robotics workbench gear, environmental sensors, 3D prototyping tools, and digital courseware designed for students, teachers, and prospective educators.

Daily experiential learning workshops and teacher capacity building sessions.
